verdict.rationale: Temporal's self-hosted guide documents Namespace-level retention configuration and Archival for extending or managing retention of Workflow Histories, giving admins control over how long data is kept (temporal-docs-6, temporal-docs-8, temporal-docs-22, temporal-docs-24). However there is no explicit documentation of on-demand/manual deletion APIs, GDPR-style erasure, or deletion controls beyond retention-period expiry. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/erasure API documentation, tooling for ad-hoc data purge, independent confirmation that retention settings are reliably enforced.
